title: The Placebo Effect: How Can Belief Heal?
question: Why do inert treatments sometimes produce real relief, and how much of the placebo effect is genuine biology rather than statistical illusion?
summary: The placebo effect is part statistical artifact and part genuine neurobiology: expectation and conditioning can trigger the brain's own opioids and dopamine, ritual and context shape outcomes, and even openly labeled placebos and their dark twin, the nocebo effect, reveal how deeply belief shapes bodily experience.
